newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek 12M T-bill rate to be cut to 12.7pct - min.
newsitem.headline: Greek 12M T-bill rate to be cut to 12.7pct - min.

text.p: Greece's 12-month T-bill rate will be cut by 10 basis points to 12.70 percent in the September 2 issue, Finance Minister Alexandros Papadopoulos told the nightly news of state ET 1 TV station on Tuesday.

"There is such a climate of confidence and stability that I have the opportunity to announce tonight that interest rates of state securities will be reduced by 10 basis points from 12.80 percen to 12.70 percent," Papadopoulos was quoted as saying by a press ministry statement.
This is happening for the first time during a pre-election period in Greece's history despite the big borrowing needs of the state in September, he added.
National elections will be held on September 22. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
